screen.analog_alu.boule.title: Silicon Boule Process
screen.analog_alu.boule.line1: Combine sand and a diamond to make a silicon boule.
screen.analog_alu.boule.line2: Blast for 1,200 ticks to make metallurgical silicon.
screen.analog_alu.boule.line3: Combine silicon with nether quartz for a purification charge.
screen.analog_alu.boule.line4: Blast for 2,400 ticks to obtain purified silicon.
screen.analog_alu.boule.line5: Add an amethyst seed, then grow a crystal for 3,000 ticks.
screen.analog_alu.boule.line6: Use a cutting wire on the crystal to get eight wafers.
screen.analog_alu.analyzer.title: Mass Analyzer Operation
screen.analog_alu.analyzer.line1: Throw ion-implanted silicon onto the machine.
screen.analog_alu.analyzer.line2: Power it with copper wire or redstone.
screen.analog_alu.analyzer.line3: Supply signal strength 8+ for 2.5 cumulative minutes.
screen.analog_alu.analyzer.line4: Progress pauses without signal and resumes later; input is retained.
screen.analog_alu.analyzer.line5: Accumulate 3,000 powered ticks to finish processing.
screen.analog_alu.analyzer.line6: Mass-selected silicon is ejected above the machine.
screen.analog_alu.wafer.title: Silicon Wafer Editor
screen.analog_alu.wafer.instruction_orde: Module first; declare ports/storage before statements (1 ms each).
screen.analog_alu.wafer.instruction_widt: 4-bit values; CRAM + rounded-up FF bytes must be <= 512.
screen.analog_alu.wafer.example: Example: let c = (a ++ b).carry; front = +(a, b);
block.analog_alu.mass_analyzer.descripti: Throw in ion-implanted silicon; supply signal strength 8+ for 2.5 cumulative minutes. Progress pauses without signal.
message.analog_alu.wafer_no_program: No valid compiled wafer program is stored.
hover.analog_alu.hint.oil_processor_heat: Needs lava, fire, or a lit furnace/campfire directly below
hover.analog_alu.hint.rechargeable: Charges when wired to a generator
book.analog_alu.guide.page1:
ANALOG ALU
Guide Book

Contents
1. Oil
2. Oil Processor
3. Electricity
4. Generators
5. Batteries
6. Miner & Hoppers
7. Silicon
8. Utilities
9. Converters
book.analog_alu.guide.page2:
1. OIL

Oil forms large underground deposits. Most of them show up as wide black lakes on the surface.

Right-click an oil source with an empty bucket to collect 1 Oil. The bucket is not used up, and Oil stacks to 64.
book.analog_alu.guide.page3:
Oil flows slowly. Inside it you can barely see and you slowly drown. Respiration and Water Breathing do not help.

Oil Drill: place it above a deposit. Every 30 s it pumps up one source within 64 blocks below.

Solid Oil smelts into Oil.
book.analog_alu.guide.page4:
2. OIL PROCESSOR

Right-click with Oil to fill it (sneak to insert the stack). It holds 64, and hoppers can fill it too.

It needs heat directly below: lava, fire, or a lit furnace or campfire.

After 20 s, each Oil becomes Diesel, Plastic Resin and Asphalt.
book.analog_alu.guide.page5:
3. ELECTRICITY

Copper Cable carries current. Devices connect through two terminals: the front is +, the back is -. Current needs a closed loop from + back to -.

Look at a cable or device to see its voltage, current and temperature.
book.analog_alu.guide.page6:
Each circuit may have only one generator or Battery. Too much current overheats and damages cables.

Circuit Switch: right-click to open or close it.

Resistive Load: a 10 Ω test load.
book.analog_alu.guide.page7:
4. GENERATORS

Coal: 12 V. Right-click with coal.
Diesel: 24 V. Right-click with Diesel; holds 128.
Sneak-click inserts the stack. Hoppers can refuel both.

Wind: open sky at Y 80+.
Solar: daylight and open sky.
book.analog_alu.guide.page8:
5. BATTERIES

Battery: 9 V, 36 kJ. Starts full and cannot be recharged. Once placed, mining it gives a Used Battery (0 J).

Rechargeable Battery: 12 V, 72 kJ. Starts empty. Wire it into a circuit with a generator to charge it. Without a generator it powers the circuit itself. It keeps its charge when mined.
book.analog_alu.guide.page9:
6. MINER & HOPPERS

Miner: with 4 V or more and a redstone signal, it breaks the block in front of it. Its terminals are top/bottom or the two sides.

Hoppers can feed the Oil Processor, generators and the Mass Analyzer.
book.analog_alu.guide.page10:
7. SILICON

Sand + diamond = Silicon Boule. Blast it into Silicon. Add quartz and blast for Purified Silicon. Add an amethyst shard and blast for Monocrystalline Silicon. Cut it with a Wafer Cutting Wire into 8 wafers.
book.analog_alu.guide.page11:
Program a wafer, add quartz and blast it. Feed the result to a Mass Analyzer with signal 8+. Surround the output with 8 redstone torches, add Strong Ion Gas, and blast for a Semiconductor.

Book + redstone = programming guide.
book.analog_alu.guide.page12:
8. UTILITIES

Chunk Loader keeps its chunk loaded; Chunk Loader II loads 3x3 chunks.

Upward Hopper moves items up. Sneak-right-click toggles ejection.

CRAM, gates and LEDs treat redstone strength 0-15 as a 4-bit value.
book.analog_alu.guide.page13:
9. CONVERTERS

They link two circuits. Input: front + / back -. Output: top + / bottom -.

Step-Up: 24 V up to 3 kV.
Step-Down: down to 4 V.
Right-click raises the setting; sneak-right-click lowers it.

Efficiency is 90%. A weak source makes the output sag.
tooltip.analog_alu.revolver: Press R to cock before every shot. Once all six are gone, R reloads (4 s)
tooltip.analog_alu.musket: Loads one ball at a time as it fires. 3 s between shots
tooltip.analog_alu.shotgun: R reloads (3.5 s) for two shots

message.analog_alu.gun.musket_loads_itse: The musket loads itself as it fires
